product_one_liner.value: Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that automates infrastructure-as-code provisioning, configuration, and governance for DevOps, platform, and SRE teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its infrastructure orchestration platform as managing provisioning, configuration, and governance, and says it serves DevOps, platform, and SRE teams.

pricing_page.notes: Spacelift has a public page titled Plans and Pricing, which directly establishes a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Spacelift’s customer stories name Figma, 1Password, and Handshake as customers. | named_customers.0: The customer stories page names Figma in a customer success story. | named_customers.1: Spacelift’s customer story names 1Password. | named_customers.2: Spacelift’s case study identifies Handshake as its customer.

employee_band.notes: Spacelift reports more than 130 employees, while its LinkedIn profile places company size in the 51–200 range; together these support the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Spacelift’s LinkedIn company profile directly lists Redwood City as its headquarters city. | hq_country: The LinkedIn company profile identifies its headquarters as Redwood City, California; this identifies the U.S. headquarters location.

founded_year.notes: Spacelift’s careers page states it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog index presents a webinar and a practitioner guide promotion, not at least two posts by engineers explaining how the product is built, so it does not meet the specified threshold.

public_docs.notes: Spacelift’s public documentation site contains multiple linked support, FAQ, getting-started, and product documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists all eight open roles; none of the titles is an AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role.

model_provider.value: Amazon Bedrock (AWS) and Anthropic Claude models
model_provider.notes: Spacelift’s AI terms name Amazon Bedrock and Anthropic Claude models as the AI service/model combination.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Spacelift’s trust center names a SOC 2 Type II report, a PCI-DSS SAQ-A document, and GDPR; these support the three listed named compliance items. | compliance_certs.0: The trust center names its SOC 2 Type II report. | compliance_certs.1: The trust center lists a PCI-DSS SAQ-A document. | compliance_certs.2: The trust center names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding event in the company history is identified as a Series C in October 2024. | funding_date: The company history dates the $51M Series C to October 2024, yielding 2024-10. | funding_amount_usd: The company’s history identifies its Series C as a $51M round in October 2024; $51 million equals 51,000,000 USD.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round identified in company history is the October 2024 Series C, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Spacelift job list includes an Enterprise Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Spacelift announced the launch of Flows, a platform feature, on October 29, 2026, within the six-month window before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A May 5, 2026 announcement says John Henry Archer and Jonah Kowall joined Spacelift’s executive team as senior vice presidents, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Spacelift’s subprocessor list identifies Salesforce as CRM and HubSpot as a marketing provider. | crm_stack_signal.0: Spacelift’s subprocessor list identifies Salesforce as its CRM. | crm_stack_signal.1: Spacelift’s subprocessor list identifies HubSpot as a marketing provider.
